title: Binary Search
summary: Locate target in the increasing array nums.

contractDetails.constraints: 1–10,000 distinct integers in strictly increasing order. Each entry and target is strictly between −10,000 and 10,000.

statement: Locate target in the increasing array nums. Return its zero-based position, or −1 if it is absent. Use logarithmic time.

examples.explanation: The target is the third entry.
The target lies between entries but never occurs.
The only entry matches at position zero.

constraints: 1–10,000 distinct integers in strictly increasing order. Each entry and target is strictly between −10,000 and 10,000.
hints: Conceptual: A comparison with a middle entry rules out one side of the array.
Directional: Track the interval where the target could still be.
Implementation: Check the midpoint and keep only the side consistent with the comparison. Return −1 once the interval is empty.
complexityAnalysis: O(log n) time and O(1) auxiliary space. Each comparison halves the search interval.
